text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the race, I gave it 
everything I had to the point where I 
couldn't even speak. But I fell completely 
short.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And yet everyone was smart, had stamina, 
and had conversations too complex for me. 
...We came from entirely different worlds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, compared to her friends, 
she wasn't clever nor quick-witted. Her 
Trainer gave her plenty of guidance, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I'm an idiot. And the worst kind of 
idiot, too—one who didn't even realize 
just how stupid she was." Tosen Jordan let 
out a dry, self-deprecating laugh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't wanna look uncool anymore. And 
with that, she ran away from the Trainer, 
who was trying to propose the Osaka Hai as 
her next objective."
